preconditions.description: The input is a string containing the spell text.

preconditions.expression: all(32 <= ord(c) <= 127 or c in '\r\n' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: All characters in the input have codes from 32 to 127, or are newline characters (\r or \n).
The input ends with a newline sequence (\r\n or \n), as guaranteed by the problem statement.

preconditions.expression: any(c not in '\r\n' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input contains at least one character other than a newline.

postconditions.description: The output is non-empty and ends with a newline.

postconditions.expression: all(line.endswith('\n') for line in stdout.split('\n') if line)
postconditions.description: Each line in the output is followed by a newline.

The output is constructed by processing input lines: amplifying lines (first non-space char is '#') are preserved exactly; non-amplifying lines have all spaces removed and are concatenated with adjacent non-amplifying lines, separated by no newline; empty lines are joined to adjacent non-amplifying lines or preserved if surrounded by amplifying lines.
